newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq index ends at new high; Dow ekes out gain.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq index ends at new high; Dow ekes out gain.

text.p: The Nasdaq composite index closed at a record high Monday, powered by expectations that technology companies will report strong second-quarter results. The blue-chip market, meanwhile, eked out a small gain following a late afternoon recovery.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 1.16 points at 7,922.98. The Nasdaq index rose 21.24 points or 1.41 percent to new high of 1,523.86.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a small margin on moderate volume of 489 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
